# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment

The baseline passes the trusted simulation and has 15 LUTs and 6 FFs, but routed setup WNS is −0.946 ns while WHS is +0.167 ns, so timing is infeasible. The reported critical path runs from `rd_ptr` through distributed-memory selection to `out_last`; the advisory attributes much of the delay to the output pad and clock insertion. The first objective is timing recovery on `xc7a35tcpg236-1` at 10 ns, with setup and hold both nonnegative and all simulation, metric, and promotion gates intact. The top’s known latency requires `// @latency 1`.

## Hypothesis

Registering the FIFO head tuple and driving the output ports directly from those registers should remove the read-pointer-to-output selection path and improve routed setup slack, at the cost of additional FFs and head-update logic.

## Instruction for generator

In `packet_fifo_core`, replace the asynchronous `data_mem[rd_ptr]` and `last_mem[rd_ptr]` output reads with a registered head tuple, updating it when an empty FIFO accepts a beat and when a pop advances to the next queued beat. Handle simultaneous pop and push at occupancy one by loading the incoming tuple as the new head; preserve stall stability, exact capacity, full simultaneous transfers, explicit pointer wrap for every supported `DEPTH`, and the existing minimum transfer age. Keep the top interface and `// @latency 1` annotation unchanged, and retain a live `packet_fifo_core` instance under `packet_fifo`.
